title: 第3章：玉佩，菜摊
novel_title: 穿越两界，我在80年代当倒爷
content_zh:
说实话，马超也是第一次见这个世界的钱，不过苏雨琪那份心意，他记下了。

    看着苏雨琪离开，马超小心摊开手里的便签纸，字迹娟秀且工整，上面是苏雨琪的地址和电话号码。

    马超仅仅看了几遍，便将苏雨琪的地址和电话号码牢牢记在心里。

    也不知道是不是他的错觉。

    马超发现自己的记忆力，似乎比从前好了很多，还有后脑勺的伤疤。

    “咦？”马超发出疑惑。

    明明不久前他手还能摸到一个鼓起的包，更别提脑袋被开瓢流了不少血，不然也不会被苏雨琪看见他脑袋上的血渍。

    可现在什么都没有，鼓起的包消失了，脑袋被开瓢的位置，是一团柔顺的头发，就和脑袋其他位置长出的头发一样，别无二致。

    是幻觉吗？

    如果不是耸立的高楼大厦就在眼前，道路上无数汽车飞驰，马超或许真以为自己只是做了场梦，要知道80年代可没有这么高楼大厦，更没有这么多的汽车。

    既然想不通，那就不要想，连自己出现在2025年的事都能发生，这点小事又算的了什么？

    关键是自己要怎么回去？

    父亲瘫在床上，吃喝都要人照顾，还有自己两个妹妹一个弟弟，最大的妹妹马娟今年10岁，三弟马强6岁，而最小的妹妹马莉却只有2岁。

    换句话说，母亲王素琴，在马莉1个月大，还在吃奶的年纪，便抛下一大家子，回城里过她的逍遥日子。

    马莉还那么小，王素琴她是怎么忍心的。

    如果不是马建业双腿被野猪给拱断了，治疗需要一大笔钱，马超不会想起要回他的玉佩，这是奶奶留给他的，说是给未来孙媳妇的见面礼。

    结果被王素琴走的时候带去了城里。

    “玉佩？玉佩呢？”

    马超一个激灵，他摸遍了全身也没发现玉佩，要知道这可是他爸的治疗费。

    就在这时。

    马超感觉脑袋一阵刺痛，就好像脑袋里忽然多了什么东西，那是一扇门。

    不！

    更准确说，那是一个房间，有100平米大小，门的那边是一个黑色漩涡，仿佛要将人整个灵魂都吸进去。

    睁眼，房间消失。

    闭眼，房间又出现在脑海。

    马超试了几次，发现他只要想着房间，房间就会出现在脑海，马超心里多少安心了一点，他猜想，或许自己能出现在2025年，或许就和玉佩，以及他脑袋被开瓢有关。

    时也命也。

    就和马超猜测的一样，的确和玉佩有关。
content_en:
To be honest, it was Ma Chao's first time seeing money in this world, but he remembered Su Yuqi's thoughts.

    Watching Su Yuqi leave, Ma Chao carefully unfolded the note paper in his hand. The handwriting was beautiful and neat. On it was Su Yuqi's address and phone number.

    Ma Chao only read it a few times and remembered Su Yuqi's address and phone number in his heart.

    I don't know if it was his imagination.

    Ma Chao found that his memory seemed to be much better than before, and he also had a scar on the back of his head.

    "Huh?" Ma Chao asked in confusion.

    Obviously not long ago, he could touch a bulging lump with his hand, not to mention that his head was opened and he bled a lot, otherwise Su Yuqi would not have seen the blood stains on his head.

    But now there is nothing. The bulge has disappeared. The place where the head was opened is a ball of soft hair, just like the hair growing in other parts of the head.

    Is it an illusion?

    If it weren't for the towering high-rise buildings right in front of him and the countless cars speeding on the road, Ma Chao might have thought he was just having a dream. You must know that there were no such high-rise buildings in the 1980s, let alone so many cars.

    Since you can't figure it out, don't think about it. Even what happened to you in 2025 can happen. What does this little thing mean?

    The key is how to get back?

    The father was paralyzed on the bed and had to be taken care of for food and drink. He also had two sisters and one brother. The eldest sister Ma Juan is 10 years old, the third brother Ma Qiang is 6 years old, and the youngest sister Ma Li is only 2 years old.

    In other words, when Ma Li was 1 month old and still nursing, her mother, Wang Suqin, abandoned her entire family and returned to the city to live her happy life.

    Ma Li was still so young, how could Wang Suqin bear it?

    If Ma Jianye's legs had not been broken by a wild boar, and the treatment required a large sum of money, Ma Chao would not have thought of getting back his jade pendant, which was left to him by his grandmother as a gift for his future grandson-in-law.

    As a result, Wang Suqin took her to the city when she left.

    "Jade pendant? Where is the jade pendant?"

    Ma Chao was shocked. He felt all over his body but couldn't find the jade pendant. You must know that this was his father's treatment fee.

    Just then.

    Ma Chao felt a tingling sensation in his head, as if something suddenly appeared in his head. It was a door.

    No!

    To be more precise, it was a room, 100 square meters in size. On the other side of the door was a black vortex, as if it wanted to suck in a person's entire soul.

    Open your eyes and the room disappears.

    Close your eyes and the room comes to mind again.

    Ma Chao tried several times and found that as long as he thought about the room, the room would appear in his mind. Ma Chao felt a little more at ease. He guessed that maybe he could appear in 2025, maybe it had something to do with the jade pendant and his head being opened.

    Time is also destiny.

    Just as Ma Chao guessed, it is indeed related to the jade pendant.
